title: stake(amount, recipient) lets anyone forcibly re-anchor a victim's reward-debt clock, harvesting their pending rewards to them prematurely (rewards-side griefing)
rootCause: `stake(amount, recipient)` lets any caller pass any `recipient`. Triggers `_claimRewards(recipient)` if `recipient.amount > 0`, forcing a taxable / state-anchoring event on the victim's schedule.
impactSummary: Forced-claim grief enabling: (a) forced taxable event, (b) selective DoS pivot via USDC blacklist or DEDUP-012 path, (c) MEV grief (force claim before a collectReward boost).
preservedDetails: ECON-007 carries the enumeration of harm vectors that sharpens profile §4.3's 'minor / benign' label.
remediation: Require recipient == msg.sender OR per-recipient approval mapping; adopt V2's migrator role.
dedupNotes: Profile-flagged as 'minor / benign'. Borderline finding — likely demoted to QA-bundle.
